<style>
:root{
  --blue:#1E427F;--blue2:#153360;--yellow:#F2C94C;--sky:#E2ECF6;--warm:#F8F7F3;
  --green:#667A4A;--greenSoft:#E9EDE2;--gold:#D6A23C;--ink:#20242A;--muted:#626A75;--line:#DCE3EA;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}html{scroll-behavior:smooth}body{margin:0;font-family:"Noto Sans TC","PingFang TC","Microsoft JhengHei",sans-serif;background:var(--warm);color:var(--ink)}a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}img{max-width:100%}
.site-header{position:fixed;z-index:50;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:74px;padding:0 clamp(20px,4vw,64px);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:30px;background:rgba(248,247,243,.86);backdrop-filter:blur(18px);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(30,66,127,.08)}
.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-right:auto}.brand-mark{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;background:var(--blue2);color:var(--gold);font-family:serif;font-size:20px;font-weight:900;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(214,162,60,.38)}.brand>span:last-child{display:flex;flex-direction:column}.brand b{color:var(--blue)}.brand small{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted)}
nav{display:flex;gap:21px;font-size:14px;color:var(--blue2)}nav a:hover{color:var(--blue)}
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:48px;padding:0 22px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--blue);color:#fff;font-weight:700;box-shadow:0 10px 28px rgba(30,66,127,.15);transition:.2s}.btn:hover{transform:translateY(-1px);box-shadow:0 14px 30px rgba(30,66,127,.2)}.btn-small{min-height:38px;padding:0 16px;font-size:13px}.btn-ghost{background:transparent;color:var(--blue);border:1px solid rgba(30,66,127,.22);box-shadow:none}
.hero{position:relative;min-height:100svh;padding:145px clamp(24px,8vw,120px) 80px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.05fr .95fr;align-items:center;overflow:hidden;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#f8f7f3 0%,#edf4fa 48%,#e0edf7 100%)}#hero-canvas{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;opacity:.58}.hero-glow{position:absolute;width:46vw;height:46vw;border-radius:50%;right:-8vw;top:12vh;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(242,201,76,.34),rgba(242,201,76,0) 66%)}.hero-copy,.hero-person{position:relative;z-index:2}.eyebrow,.section-kicker{letter-spacing:.18em;font-size:12px;font-weight:800;color:var(--blue)}.hero h1{font-size:clamp(64px,8vw,132px);line-height:.91;letter-spacing:-.065em;color:var(--blue2);margin:18px 0 28px}.hero h1 span{position:relative}.hero h1 span:after{content:"";position:absolute;left:-2%;right:0;bottom:-10px;height:16px;background:var(--yellow);transform:skewX(-18deg) rotate(-2deg);z-index:-1;border-radius:50%}.lead{font-size:clamp(22px,2.2vw,34px);font-weight:800;color:var(--blue);margin:0 0 12px}.hero-note{max-width:520px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.9}.cta-row{display:flex;gap:12px;margin-top:32px;flex-wrap:wrap}.hero-person{height:min(78vh,820px);display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:center}.hero-person>img{height:100%;max-width:100%;object-fit:contain;filter:drop-shadow(0 28px 28px rgba(21,51,96,.14))}.sun-disc{position:absolute;width:70%;aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:50%;background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(242,201,76,.82),rgba(242,201,76,.06));right:0;top:9%;z-index:-1}.quote-chip{position:absolute;right:-1vw;bottom:7%;padding:14px 18px;border-left:4px solid var(--yellow);background:rgba(248,247,243,.88);backdrop-filter:blur(10px);font-weight:700;color:var(--blue2);line-height:1.55}.place-tags{position:absolute;left:4vw;bottom:24px;display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;z-index:3}.place-tags span{font-size:11px;padding:8px 11px;border:1px solid rgba(30,66,127,.14);border-radius:999px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.64);color:var(--blue)}
.section{padding:110px clamp(24px,8vw,120px)}.intro{background:#fff}.intro-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.9fr 1.1fr;gap:10vw;margin-top:20px}.intro h2,.section h2{font-size:clamp(40px,5vw,74px);line-height:1.08;letter-spacing:-.045em;margin:12px 0;color:var(--blue2)}.intro p,.section-head p,.service-copy p,.future p,.contact p,.place-copy p{font-size:17px;line-height:1.95;color:var(--muted)}.text-link{display:inline-block;margin-top:12px;font-weight:800;color:var(--blue);border-bottom:3px solid var(--yellow)}.section-head{display:flex;align-items:end;justify-content:space-between;gap:40px;margin-bottom:42px}.section-head>p{max-width:570px}
.place-story{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#F8F7F3 0%,#EEF5F8 100%);position:relative;overflow:hidden}.place-story:before{content:"";position:absolute;width:560px;height:560px;border-radius:50%;right:-220px;top:120px;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(102,122,74,.13),transparent 68%)}.place-intro{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:7vw;align-items:end;margin-bottom:52px}.place-copy{max-width:650px}.place-emphasis{font-weight:900;color:var(--blue2)!important;border-left:4px solid var(--yellow);padding-left:18px}.place-layout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.45fr) minmax(320px,.55fr);gap:34px;align-items:start}.map-shell{position:relative;border-radius:32px;background:#fff;padding:18px;box-shadow:0 30px 80px rgba(30,66,127,.10);border:1px solid rgba(30,66,127,.08);overflow:hidden}.map-toolbar{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;padding:6px 8px 16px;color:var(--blue2);font-size:13px;font-weight:800}.map-toolbar span:last-child{font-weight:500;color:var(--muted);font-size:11px}.map-shell>img{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;border-radius:22px;background:#f7fafb}.map-shell canvas{position:absolute;inset:64px 18px 18px;width:calc(100% - 36px);height:calc(100% - 82px);pointer-events:none;opacity:.28}.place-points{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}.place-points article{display:grid;grid-template-columns:44px 1fr;gap:14px;padding:18px 18px 18px 16px;border-radius:20px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.72);border:1px solid rgba(30,66,127,.08);transition:.25s}.place-points article:hover{transform:translateX(5px);background:#fff;box-shadow:0 18px 50px rgba(30,66,127,.08)}.place-points article>span{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;background:var(--yellow);color:var(--blue2);font-size:12px;font-weight:900}.place-points h3{margin:0 0 5px;color:var(--blue2);font-size:18px}.place-points p{margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:14px;line-height:1.75}.place-ribbon{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(6,1fr);margin-top:34px;border-top:1px solid rgba(30,66,127,.12);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(30,66,127,.12)}.place-ribbon span{text-align:center;padding:18px 8px;font-weight:900;color:var(--blue);border-right:1px solid rgba(30,66,127,.09);font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.04em}.place-ribbon span:last-child{border-right:0}
.actions{background:var(--warm)}.action-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:16px}.action-grid.five article:nth-child(4),.action-grid.five article:nth-child(5){grid-column:span 1}.action-grid article{min-height:245px;padding:28px;border-radius:24px;background:#fff;border:1px solid rgba(30,66,127,.08);transition:.3s;position:relative;overflow:hidden}.action-grid article:after{content:"";position:absolute;right:-28px;bottom:-28px;width:96px;height:96px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(242,201,76,.09)}.action-grid article:hover{transform:translateY(-5px);box-shadow:0 24px 50px rgba(30,66,127,.08)}.action-grid b{color:#B18A1F;font-size:14px}.action-grid h3{font-size:24px;color:var(--blue);margin:24px 0 12px}.action-grid p{color:var(--muted);line-height:1.8;margin:0}
.service{background:var(--sky)}.status{padding:10px 14px;border-radius:999px;background:#fff;color:var(--blue);font-size:13px;font-weight:800}.service-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.72fr 1.28fr;gap:6vw}.service-copy h3{font-size:42px;color:var(--blue2);margin:0 0 20px}.service-copy ol{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:26px 0}.service-copy li{padding:12px 0 12px 28px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(30,66,127,.12);position:relative}.service-copy li:before{content:"●";position:absolute;left:0;color:var(--yellow)}blockquote{margin:28px 0 0;padding:22px;border-left:4px solid var(--yellow);background:rgba(255,255,255,.62);font-size:20px;font-weight:800;color:var(--blue2);line-height:1.7}.before-after{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px}.before-after figure{margin:0;position:relative;overflow:hidden;border-radius:24px;background:#ddd;min-height:480px}.before-after img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}.before-after figcaption{position:absolute;left:14px;bottom:14px;background:rgba(20,35,57,.78);color:#fff;padding:8px 12px;border-radius:999px;font-size:12px}.field-records figure{min-height:520px}
.timeline{background:#fff;overflow:hidden}.timeline-track{display:flex;gap:16px;overflow-x:auto;padding-bottom:16px;scroll-snap-type:x mandatory}.timeline-track article{flex:0 0 min(320px,78vw);scroll-snap-align:start}.timeline-track img{width:100%;aspect-ratio:4/5;object-fit:cover;border-radius:20px;filter:saturate(.82)}.timeline-track .turning img{filter:saturate(.68) sepia(.05)}.timeline-track span{display:block;color:#A57D13;font-weight:900;font-size:12px;margin-top:15px;letter-spacing:.08em}.timeline-track h3{margin:6px 0;font-size:19px;color:var(--blue2)}
.future{padding:0}.future-bg{padding:120px clamp(24px,8vw,120px);background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--blue2),var(--blue));color:#fff;overflow:hidden;position:relative}.future-bg:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-30%;background:radial-gradient(circle at 70% 40%,rgba(242,201,76,.18),transparent 28%)}.future-grid{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:6vw;align-items:center}.future h2{color:#fff}.future h2 span{color:var(--yellow)}.future p{color:rgba(255,255,255,.75)}.light{color:var(--yellow)}.future-link{display:inline-block;margin-top:16px;color:#fff;font-weight:800;border-bottom:3px solid var(--yellow)}.future-orbit{height:420px;position:relative;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.16);border-radius:50%}.future-orbit:after,.future-orbit:before{content:"";position:absolute;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);border-radius:50%;inset:12%}.future-orbit:after{inset:28%}.core{position:absolute;inset:50% auto auto 50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);width:128px;height:128px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;background:var(--yellow);color:var(--blue2);font-size:24px;font-weight:900}.future-orbit span{position:absolute;padding:9px 12px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);font-size:12px}.future-orbit span:nth-child(1){left:12%;top:18%}.future-orbit span:nth-child(2){right:11%;top:22%}.future-orbit span:nth-child(3){right:5%;bottom:32%}.future-orbit span:nth-child(4){left:14%;bottom:18%}.future-orbit span:nth-child(5){left:42%;top:7%}
.contact{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:40px;background:var(--warm)}.contact-actions{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start}
footer{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:20px;padding:28px clamp(24px,8vw,120px);background:#101720;color:rgba(255,255,255,.72);font-size:13px}.footer-brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px}.footer-brand img{width:34px;height:34px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid rgba(214,162,60,.35)}
@media(max-width:1100px){nav{gap:14px;font-size:13px}.place-layout{grid-template-columns:1fr}.place-points{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
@media(max-width:980px){nav{display:none}.hero{grid-template-columns:1fr;padding-top:120px}.hero-copy{padding-right:20%}.hero-person{height:56vh;margin-top:-40px;justify-content:flex-end}.hero-person>img{max-width:72%}.quote-chip{right:0}.intro-grid,.service-grid,.future-grid,.place-intro{grid-template-columns:1fr}.action-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.before-after figure{min-height:360px}.section-head,.contact{align-items:flex-start;flex-direction:column}.future-orbit{max-width:560px;width:100%;margin:auto}.place-ribbon{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}}
@media(max-width:640px){.site-header{height:64px;padding:0 16px}.brand small{display:none}.btn-small{display:none}.hero{padding:106px 20px 44px;min-height:auto}.hero-copy{padding-right:0}.hero h1{font-size:64px}.hero-person{height:48vh;margin-top:0}.hero-person>img{max-width:92%;margin-left:auto}.quote-chip{font-size:12px;bottom:2%}.place-tags{position:relative;left:auto;bottom:auto;margin-top:18px}.section{padding:78px 20px}.intro-grid{gap:24px}.action-grid,.place-points{grid-template-columns:1fr}.before-after{grid-template-columns:1fr}.before-after figure,.field-records figure{min-height:300px}.section-head{margin-bottom:26px}.future-bg{padding:78px 20px}.future-orbit{height:300px}.contact{padding-bottom:88px}footer{flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;padding:24px 20px}.map-shell{padding:10px;border-radius:22px}.map-toolbar{padding:6px 6px 10px}.map-toolbar span:last-child{display:none}.map-shell>img{border-radius:16px}.place-ribbon{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){html{scroll-behavior:auto}.btn,.place-points article,.action-grid article{transition:none}.btn:hover,.place-points article:hover,.action-grid article:hover{transform:none}}
